_meta.description: Stylistic archetypes per position. We never publish childhood scores of these professionals — these are public, well-known stylistic comparisons only. Archetypes are matched server-side: for each archetype we compute a weighted average across its anchor_attrs from the player's actual scores; the highest-scoring archetype wins, but only if the match score is >= 6.0 (otherwise we show 'developing — no clear archetype yet').

goalkeeper.name: Modern sweeper-keeper
goalkeeper.summary: Plays high, sweeps behind the defence and starts attacks with the ball at his feet.

goalkeeper.name: Commanding shot-stopper
goalkeeper.summary: Traditional shot-stopper who keeps clean sheets through reflexes and presence.

goalkeeper.name: Athletic distributor
goalkeeper.summary: Sets the tempo from the back with two-footed distribution and composure.

goalkeeper.name: Agile aerialist
goalkeeper.summary: Owns the box on crosses and uses athleticism to recover impossible saves.

centre back.name: Ball-playing modern CB
centre back.summary: Composed centre-back who carries possession and starts attacks from deep.

centre back.name: Commanding leader
centre back.summary: Orchestrates the defence with voice, position, and big-moment duels.

centre back.name: Aggressive duelist
centre back.summary: Defends with controlled aggression — closes ground and never backs out.

centre back.name: Athletic enforcer
centre back.summary: Plays a higher line confidently because his recovery pace covers most threats.

centre back.name: Positional master
centre back.summary: Defends with the brain — wins through anticipation, not athleticism.

full back.name: Creative playmaker FB
full back.summary: An auxiliary playmaker who creates chances from full-back.

full back.name: Inverted technical FB
full back.summary: Drifts into midfield to overload the centre and dictate tempo.

full back.name: Explosive athlete FB
full back.summary: Pure athletic engine — gets up and down the flank all day.

full back.name: Defensive specialist
full back.summary: Stops attacks before they start — built to defend, not raid forward.

full back.name: Attacking expressive FB
full back.summary: Plays like a winger from full-back — direct, brave, expressive.

defensive midfielder.name: Tempo controller
defensive midfielder.summary: The metronome — sets the speed of every attack through composed passing.

defensive midfielder.name: Destroyer
defensive midfielder.summary: Wins the ball, kills attacks at source, lets others play.

defensive midfielder.name: Positional intelligence
defensive midfielder.summary: Defends without running — reads the game two moves ahead.

defensive midfielder.name: Mobile interceptor
defensive midfielder.summary: All-action ball-winner who covers every blade of grass.

defensive midfielder.name: Deep-lying playmaker
defensive midfielder.summary: Plays as the conductor — both-footed range and a calm decision-maker.

central midfielder.name: Vision-driven playmaker
central midfielder.summary: A player who sees what others miss and unlocks defences with one pass.

central midfielder.name: Press-resistant box-to-box
central midfielder.summary: Composes the team out of trouble — never panics with the ball.

central midfielder.name: Range-passing #8
central midfielder.summary: Long-range passer who hurts defences from anywhere on the pitch.

central midfielder.name: Box-to-box engine
central midfielder.summary: Covers every blade of grass — leads through work rate and arrivals.

central midfielder.name: Metronome
central midfielder.summary: Keeps possession ticking — every pass perfectly weighted, the engine hums.

attacking midfielder.name: Modric-type composer
attacking midfielder.summary: Composed playmaker who controls tempo with scanning and elite ball-handling.

attacking midfielder.name: Pedri-type press-breaker
attacking midfielder.summary: Press-resistant micro-genius — escapes pressure to find the next pass.

attacking midfielder.name: Chance-creating #10
attacking midfielder.summary: Plays between the lines and unlocks defences with vision and movement.

attacking midfielder.name: Shadow striker
attacking midfielder.summary: An AM who finishes like a striker — ghosting into the box for arrivals.

attacking midfielder.name: Technical dribbler
attacking midfielder.summary: Unlocks defences with the dribble — close control beats the press.

winger.name: Explosive direct winger
winger.summary: Pure vertical threat — pace and directness in straight lines.

winger.name: Cutting-inside finisher
winger.summary: Plays inverted — shifts inside and threatens with shot or final pass.

winger.name: Two-footed creator
winger.summary: Equally dangerous either side — creates as much as he finishes.

winger.name: Pressing & threat winger
winger.summary: Modern complete winger — defends, presses, and threatens in transition.

winger.name: 1v1 dribble specialist
winger.summary: The classic 1v1 winger — receives, isolates, and beats his marker.

striker.name: Penalty-box predator
striker.summary: Pure penalty-box predator — every chance finishes in the net.

striker.name: Deep-lying complete 9
striker.summary: Plays as a #9 + #10 hybrid — drops deep, links play, finishes chances.

striker.name: Technical finisher
striker.summary: Finishes with whatever foot, from any angle — pure technical executioner.

striker.name: Link-play target
striker.summary: Plays with his back to goal — the focal point that everything goes through.

striker.name: Explosive runner
striker.summary: Stretches teams by running in behind — pure pace makes everyone deeper.
